messages:
Sam B: noticing a weird slowdown in scheduling for low-req jobs in eu-west1 — many small GPU jobs are getting split across nodes instead of packing, causing a spike in evictions and queue time.
Lei Chen: saw the same, spot/ondemand mix? any taints changed recently?
Sam B: nope — node labels unchanged. noticed descheduler kicked in and started breaking pods with anti-affinity. logs: `descheduler: removed pod due to topologySpreadConstraint` — also kube-scheduler backpressure.
Alex R: can you paste `kubectl get pods -A | grep Evicted`? also is gang-scheduling enabled for those jobs?
Sam B: here: ```bash
$ kubectl get pods -n ml -o wide | grep Evicted
train-job-7x   Evicted   0   3d   node/gpu-a1   eu-west1
train-job-8y   Evicted   0   2d   node/gpu-b3   eu-west1
```
Sam B: jobs use a gang annotation `scheduling.gang=yes` but we recently rolled a change to allow partial gang fallthrough.
Maria G: that fallthrough tweak could cause atomization — scheduler now tries to place any singleton, so small jobs end up scattered. also saw increased KV cache pressure on some instances, leading to OOM kills?
Infra Bot: [alert] node gpu-b3 eviction spike: 11 pods in 1h, autoscaler scaled down 2 nodes.
Sam B: autoscaler scale-down + descheduler = perfect storm. scale-down is reclaiming underutilized nodes, but pods get preempted and rescheduled across AZs -> cross-az bandwidth spike.
Lei Chen: could be the packing thresholds changed for mixed instance types. @ops-runner, any recent cluster-autoscaler config changes?
ops-runner: I flipped binpack threshold from 0.2 -> 0.15 yesterday to optimize cost, intended to squeeze more pods per node.
Alex R: that explains it — lower threshold caused nodes to be considered "nearly full", autoscaler evicts non-guaranteed pods sooner. Combined with partial gang fallthrough, fragmentation skyrockets.
Maria G: short-term mitigation: revert threshold to 0.25 and re-enable strict gang enforcement for training namespace. Also add a descheduler exclusion label for gang-critical pods: `gang-protect=true`.
Sam B: I'll open a revert PR and roll to eu-west1 only. Can someone monitor KV cache OOMs and NIC saturation?
Lei Chen: I'll run a quick defrag job: `kubectl apply -f defrag-job.yaml -n infra` — it will cordon small nodes and drain to consolidate GPUs.
Alex R: monitor cost impact — pack better but watch latency. set alert if evictions > 5/min.
Infra Bot: incident created: INC-2026-1423 "sparse-slot fragmentation eu-west1" assigned to eng-platform.
Sam B: thanks. Will post updates once PR merges. :thumbsup:
Maria G: and let's add a postmortem note to eng-platform/ops board after stabilization.
